verdict.rationale: Factory Missions let a user 'work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written' (docs-22, docs-40), and Jira/Linear issue assignment lets Droid 'investigate, implement, and test the work' (docs-36, docs-37), which maps loosely onto turning a feedback item into a scoped task. However there is no evidence of a dedicated feedback-intake workflow or artifact that explicitly converts unstructured user feedback into a structured task with a proposed scope for PM review. Missing for 10: explicit feedback-ingestion mechanism, a PM-facing 'proposed scope' output artifact distinct from code Missions, and any example of this end-to-end flow.
